Infantile psoriasis is rare, often misdiagnosed as seborrheic or atopic dermatitis; sebopsoriasis may mimic seborrheic dermatitis but tends to have sharper margins, thicker scale, and less greasiness—low pretest probability without other stigmata (e.g., nail pitting, family history, or extensor plaques).
